title: What comes next
narration: Several new battery types are on the way. Toyota aims to launch its first car with an all-solid-state battery by 2028, and BYD plans to sell its first from 2027. Sodium-ion batteries use sodium instead of lithium, and CATL says large-scale production is due by the fourth quarter of 2026. And BYD claims its second-generation Blade battery charges from 10 to 70 percent in five minutes on its own ultra-fast chargers. For now, these are targets and claims, not everyday reality.

visual_content.heading: Announced next-generation batteries
bullets: Solid-state: Toyota targets its first car by 2028
Sodium-ion: CATL large-scale production due by late 2026
Faster charging: BYD claims 10–70% in 5 minutes on its 1,500-kW chargers
